sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority for the traffic signs and pavement markings section (North Carolina regular Class C)
Issuer: the North Carolina Department of Transportation, Division of Motor Vehicles (NCDMV) publishes the handbook and administers the license tests [A01].
Source document: North Carolina Driver Handbook, back cover revision note Revised May 2025 [A03].
Test structure for an original license: vision check, traffic signs test, knowledge test on traffic laws and safe driving, and an on-road test, each passed separately [A02].
This section feeds the knowledge test: regulatory, warning and guide signs identified by shape and color, where to stop for a stop sign, the yield duty, route markers and highway numbering, center and edge lines, the two-way left-turn lane, colored pavement markers and traffic officer signals; this content also feeds the separate traffic signs test.
Not stated in the handbook: the knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit; they stay unknown and are never shown to learners (verify NC-SGN-A-EXAM).
Practice quizzes follow the product mastery policy from the learning loop, which is not an official exam threshold.
